title: France faces record heatwave with deaths and crop threats
summary: France experienced its hottest day on record during a severe heatwave that resulted in multiple fatalities, including children found dead inside parked cars. Authorities forecast temperatures reaching up to 43 degrees Celsius (109 Fahrenheit), threatening food production and outdoor workers.
summary_points: Two young children were found deceased inside a parked car while three elderly people died from heat exposure at home.
